description: This file defines the Free shipping method model in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It contains the logic to determine if free shipping should be offered based on geographic zone and cart subtotal, and provides the shipping method details accordingly.

classes.name: Free
classes.description: Model class for free shipping option, extending the base Model class in OpenCart framework. Responsible for providing shipping quote details based on configured rules.

methods.name: getQuote
methods.description: Calculates and returns the shipping method data if free shipping conditions are met, based on geographic zone and subtotal.
